chunks: And in the narration of Sama'ah:
"She is entitled to the dowry if he had consummated the marriage with her."

key_terms.الْمَهْرُ: the dowry owed to the wife in marriage
key_terms.بِهَا: with her, referring to the wife
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: Sama'ah, the narrator to whom this report is attributed

ai.seo_question: Is a woman entitled to the dowry if the marriage was consummated?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding a woman's entitlement to the mahr in a marital case tied to consummation. It indicates that if the husband had consummated the marriage with her, then the dowry is established for her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2712 - In the narration of Sama'ah:
"She is entitled to the dowry if he had consummated the marriage with her."
